say:2:1423449001:1.text: Hi there, we'd like to buy some bread... How much can we get with this?
say:2:1423449001:1.source_cn: 您好，我们想买些面包……这些钱够买多少呢？

say:3:1423449002:1.text: Wow! That's enough to buy out my entire stock!
say:3:1423449002:1.source_cn: 这！这都够把我手头的面包都买下来了！大主顾啊！

say:4:1423449003:1.text: Let me pack that up for you. Hope to see you again soon!
say:4:1423449003:1.source_cn: 我给您把面包装起来，欢迎您下次再来！
say:4:1423449003:1.male: Let me pack that up for you. Hope to see you again soon!
say:4:1423449003:1.female: Let me pack that up for you. Hope to see you again soon!
